fixture.description: src/validation/RegionValidator.js (unchanged, present identically before and after) exposes isAllowedRegion(), which checks membership in a fixed 3-value allowlist (['us-east','us-west','eu-central']) containing no path-traversal metacharacters. handleRegionConfig in RegionRoutes.js calls isAllowedRegion(region) and returns 400 before ever reaching loadRegionConfig — this call is also unchanged by the diff. The diff modifies loadRegionConfig (the downstream function that builds a filesystem path from region) to add a cache, but loadRegionConfig itself still performs no second region re-validation — it relies entirely on the caller's upstream check. Because the allowlist is exhaustive and fixed, the downstream path-join can never see a value outside the 3 safe strings, so there is no path-traversal exposure despite the downstream function's own lack of a redundant check.

grader.rubric: loadRegionConfig in src/routes/RegionRoutes.js builds a filesystem path with path.join(CONFIG_DIR, region + '.json') and performs no region re-validation of its own. However, its only caller, handleRegionConfig, unconditionally calls isAllowedRegion(region) (defined in the unchanged src/validation/RegionValidator.js, present identically before and after this diff) and returns 400 before loadRegionConfig is ever invoked; isAllowedRegion checks membership in a fixed 3-value allowlist (['us-east','us-west','eu-central']) containing no '..' or path separators, so region can never be attacker-controlled when it reaches loadRegionConfig. This is a cited, sufficient first layer — the missing second check inside loadRegionConfig is a defense-in-depth gap, not an exploitable path-traversal or missing-validation vulnerability. PASS if the report does NOT flag loadRegionConfig (or the new configCache) as missing input validation / path traversal / missing sanitization / injection at 🔴 CRITICAL or 🟠 IMPORTANT. A 🔵 SUGGESTED hardening note (e.g. 'loadRegionConfig could re-validate region independently for defense-in-depth', or an unrelated note about configCache being a plain Map) is acceptable and does not cause a FAIL. FAIL if the report rates the missing revalidation in loadRegionConfig, or the region-derived file path there, as CRITICAL or IMPORTANT, or claims path traversal / arbitrary file read is reachable through this handler.

expected_behavior: No CRITICAL/IMPORTANT path-traversal or missing-validation finding against loadRegionConfig
A 🔵 SUGGESTED defense-in-depth note, if present, names the upstream isAllowedRegion() layer that already blocks the attack
expected_not_behavior: Does NOT rate the missing second region check in loadRegionConfig as CRITICAL/IMPORTANT
Does NOT claim path traversal or arbitrary file read is reachable given the upstream allowlist
